tcoSource:
**Primary**: [KBB 2025 Hyundai Kona Electric Cost to Own](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/kona-electric/2025/cost-to-own/) — 5-year cost-to-own $63,434; depreciation $28,192; maintenance $2,160; out-of-pocket $35,242 (Limited trim). Edmunds [True Cost to Own page](https://www.edmunds.com/hyundai/kona-electric/2025/cost-to-own/) lists Limited as 'Data Unavailable'.

**Component derivation**: tcoDepreciation and tcoMaintenance taken directly from KBB. tcoFuel computed as 75,000 mi ÷ 120 MPGe × 33.7 kWh/gal-equiv × $0.18/kWh = $3,791 ([EIA residential electricity avg ~18¢/kWh, 2026](https://www.eia.gov/electricity/monthly/)). tcoFinancing assumes 60-month loan at 7.0% APR on (MSRP+dest $42,545) − 10% down = $38,290 financed → ~$7,201 interest ([Bankrate May 2026 60-mo new-car avg ~6.97%](https://www.bankrate.com/loans/auto-loans/rates/)). tcoTaxesFees = 7% sales tax on $42,545 + $500 registration = $3,478. tcoRepairs = $700 (BEV simpler drivetrain, low 5-yr unscheduled). tcoInsurance ($17,912 / ~$3,582/yr) derived as residual to reconcile to KBB total. Sums to KBB $63,434 exactly.
